description: Create a new schema-compatible JSON agent from a task request.
prompt:
All supplied inputs are valid; use them directly.
You may write inside agent-data/ and are read-only elsewhere.

Create a complete JSON agent definition with ID "{id}" for this task:

--- task ---
{task}
--- end task ---

Read metasrc/definitions.py and only relevant agents/*.json definitions. Match the required fields and constraints. Use the fewest useful parameters; use repo_file for repository file inputs, paper_name for explicit paper selection, and math_target for a TeX label or whole Markdown note. Green definitions return Markdown reports, yellow definitions return README or JSON artifacts, and red definitions use papers/{{paper}} only when direct resolved-paper edits are essential. Every generated prompt uses the canonical agent-data permission line for its risk.

Use the risk-appropriate prompt preamble constants defined in metasrc/definitions.py. Generated prompts must contain only the task, necessary files or tools, evidence and checks, access boundary, blocked behavior, and output contract. Treat declared values as task facts; do not discuss or perform input validation. Omit all unrelated implementation machinery. For green or yellow definitions, request one returned artifact and no edits. Ensure the ID is exactly "{id}".

Return ONLY the bare JSON object. No Markdown fence or commentary.
